lab_to_rgb — IMGMETRICS colorspace op

• Data kinds: lab → rgbimage

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.lab_to_rgb(lab, white=(0.95047, 1.0, 1.08883)) (to call the implementation directly, import imgmetrics; imgmetrics.lab_to_rgb(lab, white=(0.95047, 1.0, 1.08883)); from the registry, opsimgmetrics.get("lab_to_rgb"))

Usage

CIE L*a*b* → sRGB [0, 1]. Out-of-gamut colours are clipped, so a round trip through rgb_to_lab only matches inside the gamut (pinned by a test).

Procedure: fy = (L + 16) / 116, fx = fy + a / 500, fz = fy - b / 200 are turned back into XYZ with the inverse of xyz_to_lab (multiplying by white), the inverse of the XYZ→linear RGB matrix is applied, and then the sRGB transfer function. Before the transfer function, linear RGB is silently clipped to [0, 1] -- this is what "out-of-gamut colours are clipped" actually is, and no exception is raised.

• lab: any shape whose last axis is 3.

• white: pass the same white point as used in rgb_to_lab (not validated).

• Return value: float64 of the same shape as the input, gamma-encoded sRGB in the range [0, 1]. For 8 bit, the caller multiplies by 255 and rounds.

• Failure (MetricContractError): the last axis is not 3.
